cni_provenance.modifications_recipe: scripts/download and scripts/build in pinned K3s source; Flannel overlay, package/function rename, module replacement. Embedded x/sys v0.48.0 is replaced by v0.40.0.

limitations: Source/notice custody and recorded provenance, not legal-completeness certification.
Configured Buildroot target dependency closure is retained conservatively; this is not a bit-identical rebuild of vendor userspace.
CNI has its own embedded build graph and upstream overlay recipe; its modified vendor build has not been reproduced bit for bit.
The three replaced executables have separate source/module/build gates in sources.lock.json.
No production, Kubernetes, recovery or Portainer acceptance is established.
